items.heading: Griot
details: Key ingredients: pork shoulder, sour orange juice, garlic, scotch bonnet
Marinate pork shoulder chunks in sour orange juice, garlic and spices.
Braise the pork in its marinade until tender.
Drain and fry the pork pieces until crisp and browned outside.
Serve with pikliz (spicy pickled slaw) and fried plantains.

items.heading: Riz Djon Djon
details: Key ingredients: rice, djon djon mushrooms, shrimp, pigeon peas
Simmer dried djon djon mushrooms in water to extract their dark, earthy broth.
Strain the broth and use it to cook the rice.
Add shrimp and pigeon peas partway through cooking.
Cook until the rice turns deep black-gray and fully tender.

items.heading: Soup Joumou
details: Ingredients: vegetables, protein or legumes, onion, garlic, stock, herbs/spices and salt.
Sauté aromatics, add the remaining ingredients and stock, simmer gently until tender, then adjust seasoning.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
